## Production Systems

- NeuroDashboard (2024–2025)
  Multi-module AI platform: Knowledge Hub (RAG/pgvector over 12k+ docs),
  Analytics Dashboard, AI Insights Engine (multi-provider routing),
  Workflow Automation (BullMQ/Redis), Notes System (Socket.IO real-time),
  Document Processing Pipeline. 70k+ lines of production code.
  Stack: React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, pgvector, Socket.IO, BullMQ
  Repository: https://github.com/saralbanker/neuro-zenith

- Shade Ledger (2025–2026)
  Automated billing system for 220 rental units. Replaced manual Excel
  billing with automatic invoices, reminders, and penalty tracking.
  Saves 40+ hours of manual work every month for a live client.
  Stack: React, Node.js, react-pdf, WhatsApp Business API

- Smart Parking Management System (2023)
  Real-time parking availability and booking system.
  Stack: React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB
  Repository: https://github.com/saralbanker/smart-parking

- Carbon Compass (2023)
  Personal carbon-tracking app with actionable insights.
  Stack: React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB
  Repository: https://github.com/saralbanker/carbon-compass

## Services

- Full-stack web application development
- AI platform development (RAG, LLM integration, pgvector)
- Business automation systems
- Production deployment (database to CI/CD)

## Key Facts

- 2 production systems deployed for real clients
